references.shows: Nineteenth-century Javanese saron panerus showing bronze bars and a decorated wooden trough.
The museum bulletin describes the bronze bars and the chambers chiseled in the wooden trough.

silhouette: A low wooden trough supporting a row of bronze bars, with a single mallet above the bars.
features: Seven bronze bars in a single row
Decorated low wooden resonator beneath the bars
iconFeatures: Single row of bars in playing position
notes: Shows a Javanese panerus with one row of slendro-tuned bars.
